notes: Human NPC definitions for Tools/build_npc_humans.py (MPFB 2.0.17 bodies, CC0 MakeHuman assets; clothing from the kit in the script, CC0 Poly Haven fabrics in SourceAssets/Surfaces/Cloth). Every human is sized to the 180 cm dock worker scale (References/Original/PHASE-2.md). Macro values are MakeHuman's 0..1 sliders; tint is the cloth's colour (linear albedo): the fabric texture gives weave and grain only (greyscale, brightness-normalised), at its real-world size.

Zombie.note: The sewer's zombie (user 2026-10-03): a gaunt old man long dead, in rags, barefoot. Decayed skin and clouded eyes from Tools/build_zombie_textures.py (on the old_caucasian_male skin and grey eye).

Blacksmith.note: The plaza smith at his anvil by the forge (user 2026-10-04: a gruff white male blacksmith). Heavy shoulders and forearms, a soot-greyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, a long leather bib apron, work boots. MakeHuman has no beards; his short crop, weathered skin and heavy brows carry the gruffness.

Dwarf.note: A dwarf by the smithy (user 2026-10-04: 'a dwarf NPC by the smithy, wearing dwarven armor and holding a battle axe. Bearded.'). MakeHuman targets make him short in the leg and arm, broad and deep in the chest with a heavy neck, a big square head, big hands and feet. Armour: a padded coat under a mail shirt and split mail skirt, a steel breastplate, pauldrons and vambraces edged in brass, a helmet with a nasal, heavy boots. A long auburn beard with two braids and brass rings (built by build_npc_humans.make_beard). His battle axe: Tools/build_battle_axe.py.

TavernKeeper.note: The tavern keeper behind the bar (user 2026-10-04: like the blacksmith but with a medium-length beard and a different apron, polishing a tankard). The smith's face, brows and crop, older and heavier with less muscle; a medium greying-brown beard (make_beard, no braids); a rolled-sleeve linen shirt, dark cloth waistcoat and an off-white linen waist apron to the knee.

ElfElder.note: An old elf woman sitting on the bench by the fountain (user 2026-10-05: 'an elderly elf woman npc sitting on a bench by the fountain, long braided gray hair'). Slight and long-boned, very old (MakeHuman age near its top), the old female skin; MakeHuman targets give her long pointed ears swept back, high cheekbones, an oval face and a lift at the outer corners of the eyes. Silver hair combed back clear of the ears into one long braid down her back (build_npc_humans.make_hair); MakeHuman brows re-coloured grey (Tools/build_elf_textures.py). A long-sleeved linen shirt, a sage bodice, a long dark green skirt weighted to sit (build_npc_humans.seat_skirt), a narrow belt, soft low shoes.

GnomeAlchemist.note: The alchemist, a gnome vendor in front of the alchemist's shop (user 2026-10-05: 'a gnome in black robes, hands together behind robe sleeves so that they aren't visible, DnD 5e gnome height and facial features'). D&D 5e gnomes are 3-4 ft and slight, with prodigious noses, large bright eyes, pointed ears, pale hair that sticks out at odd angles and, the men, short carefully trimmed beards: 100 cm, an old man with a large head on short legs, a big round nose, big eyes, pointed ears, round cheeks and the corners of the mouth turned up; wild white hair (make_hair, no braid, standing tufts) and a short white beard (make_beard). A black robe with bell sleeves (the robe piece, `flare`) over a long black skirt, a dark sash and soft shoes. His hands are never seen (hide_hands: no hand mesh); the runtime holds his forearms so the cuffs meet in front of him.

Sailor.note: An old sailor on the court pier smoking a pipe (user 2026-10-05: similar looking to the tavern keeper, a shorter beard, older). The keeper's face and brows, older and leaner; a short grey beard (make_beard, no braids); a navy knit cap with a rolled cuff, a navy pea coat (the gambeson cut), dark trousers and sea boots. His pipe: Tools/build_sailor_props.py. User 2026-10-06: his hair to match his beard: grey brows (eyebrow009_grey, Tools/build_beard_textures.py) and short grey hair below the cap (make_fringe with the beard's locks).

Bobert.note: Bobert (user 2026-10-05): asleep in his barrel by the spawn, as in the 2D game (GAME-BIBLE: Chuck's home is Bobert's barrel; he never wakes and is never named). A late-middle-aged halfling, 97 cm: a small man's proportions with a slightly larger head, bigger hands and feet; bald on top with a wispy grey-brown fringe, big pointed ears (a steel ring in his right), a long drooping nose, heavy bags under the eyes, a downturned mouth, deep lines. From the supplied references: a long open ochre wool coat with a fur collar, a grey-violet scarf, a brown collared shirt, red knitted wrist warmers banded in off-white, baggy olive trousers, worn brown boots. Sleeping: closed lids (eye_texture from Tools/build_bobert_textures.py); posed seated in the barrel by ADockNPC.

PirateCaptain.note: The pirate captain (user 2026-11-02: 'Make the captain. Here are reference images ... The captain is a short Halfling but he wears very tall platform boots'; references in SourceAssets/NPCs/Humans/PirateCaptain/Reference). On deck from the start (the 2D game brings him on only at the trigger; what he does then is still to be decided). A halfling man of about 99 cm on platform soles of about 13 cm: short legs, a strong jaw and a dimpled chin, thick dark brows, dark curls to the shoulder and a waxed handlebar moustache whose ends curl up (moustache_curl, a `handlebar` groom). A burgundy frock coat to the knee with gold braid on its edges and big turned-back cuffs, brass buttons; a near-black waistcoat buttoned in brass; an open cream shirt; a belt with a big brass buckle over a red sash knotted at the hip; dark breeches; knee boots on platform soles with three buckled straps; a black tricorn edged in gold. The crew are mustachioed: a moustache, no beard.
